design_gotchas.title: Identical SOIC-8 Pinout Trap vs Push-Pull LM358DR2G / LM358DR Op-Amps
design_gotchas.detail: LM393DR2G shares the exact 8-pin SOIC layout of dual op-amps LM358DR2G, LM358DR, and LMV358IDR, but is an uncompensated open-collector comparator—NEVER swap it into an op-amp socket. Without external pull-ups its high state floats, and closing linear negative feedback triggers multi-MHz oscillation.

design_gotchas.title: Mandatory External Pull-Up Resistor & Destructive Short-to-VCC Hazard (20 mA Max Sink)
design_gotchas.detail: Outputs (Pins 1 and 7) are open-collector NPN transistors guaranteeing ISink >= 6.0 mA min (16 mA typ at VOL <= 1.5 V; 20 mA abs max). While output short-to-ground is continuous, Note 1 (p.2) and Note 3 (p.3) warn that shorting an output directly to VCC causes destructive overheating. Pull-up resistance sets both rise time and logic-high level (up to 36 V).

design_gotchas.title: Negative Input Below -0.3 V Risks Substrate Conduction & Stray-Capacitance Oscillation
design_gotchas.detail: Valid common-mode range is 0 V to VCC - 1.5 V at 25°C (VCC - 2.0 V over 0–70°C; only one input must stay in range while the other can exceed VCC, Note 8 p.3), but pulling EITHER input below -0.3 V violates ratings and risks output malfunction. Page 5 also warns to avoid routing OUT parallel to IN- and add <10 mV positive-feedback hysteresis.

design_gotchas.title: Commercial 0°C–70°C Rating & Zero Surge Margin Above 36 V (Upgraded 2 kV HBM ESD in Rev. 35)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike onsemi's 250 V HBM LM358DR2G, Rev. 35 (Nov 2026) rates LM393DR2G at 2000 V HBM / 750 V CDM ESD (p.2), making it a strong pin-for-pin second source to TI LM393DR (175.4 °C/W vs TI 148.5 °C/W). For -40°C industrial designs, select LM2903DR2G (-40..105°C) or LM2903VDR2G (-40..125°C).

typical_use_cases: Pin-for-pin second source for TI LM393DR in commercial (0°C–70°C) 2 V–36 V fault supervision and threshold detection
Wired-AND multi-rail power-good and overvoltage/undervoltage window-comparator buses
Safe open-collector level shifting from 12 V/24 V analog sensors down to 3.3 V or 5 V MCU GPIOs
Zero-crossing detectors, relaxation oscillators, and hysteresis Schmitt triggers with 200 uA/ch typ Iq
engineering_summary: The onsemi LM393DR2G is a commercial-grade (0°C to +70°C) dual open-collector voltage comparator in SOIC-8 (CASE 751, PD = 570 mW, RθJA = 175.4 °C/W) rated for 2.0 V to 36 V single-supply operation (±18 V split) with 2000 V HBM / 750 V CDM ESD (Rev. 35). Delivering 1.3 us typical response time (300 ns TTL swing), ±5 mV max offset, 20 nA typ bias current, and 200 uA/ch typ Iq, it serves as a high-confidence second source to TI LM393DR, while remaining strictly incompatible with pin-identical push-pull op-amps (LM358DR/LM358DR2G) due to its uncompensated open-collector output stage.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision on p.1 confirmed Rev. 35 (November 2026), SOIC-8 CASE 751 Top View pinout (1=Output A, 2=IN- A, 3=IN+ A, 4=GND, 5=IN+ B, 6=IN- B, 7=Output B, 8=VCC), and open-collector NPN output Q16 in Fig. 1 schematic.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.2 confirmed Maximum Ratings (VCC = +36 V / ±18 V, VO = 36 V, ISink = 20 mA, PD = 570 mW at 25°C, 1/RθJA = 5.7 mW/°C -> RθJA = 175.4 °C/W, TA = 0..70°C, TJ(max) = 150°C) and upgraded 2000 V HBM / 750 V CDM ESD ratings on LM393DG/DR2G.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.3 confirmed Electrical Characteristics (VIO = ±1.0 mV typ / ±5.0 mV max @ 25°C, IIB = 20 nA typ -> 20000 pA, tTLH = 1.3 us -> 1300 ns / 300 ns TTL, ISink = 6 mA min / 16 mA typ, ICC = 0.4 mA typ total -> 200 uA/ch); Path A verified Active ordering OPN LM393DR2G on p.7.
